reasons: The construction changes both its trigger and its uncertainty propagation, so its free-symbol and input metadata must be replaced atomically with the corrected formula.

correct: The current procedure multiplies independently enlarged entrywise intervals, losing the operator-norm geometry that justifies \(w_n\); its strict \(\widehat\gamma_{pq}+w_n<0\) trigger therefore does not imply interval termination. The corrected construction tests the symmetric source-product field and adds the rigorously derived scalar error \((2M+r_{H,n})r_{H,n}t_{\mathrm{ch}}^2\lVert z\rVert_2^2\).

narrow: The comparison \(\log(C_0Rn_\ast/0.05)\lesssim\log n_\ast\) is valid only for sufficiently large \(n_\ast\), and the original right-hand side is zero at \(n_\ast=1\). The explicit asymptotic qualifier is necessary.
The corrected claim introduces the source-product trigger, removes unused dependence on the probabilistic band theorem, and updates its free-symbol closure.

narrow: An operator-norm Hessian band of radius \(r_{H,n}\) does not make the entrywise box obtained by independently enlarging every entry by \(r_{H,n}\) an equally tight operator-norm uncertainty set: already in dimension two, the entrywise box contains \(r_{H,n}\mathbf 1\mathbf 1^{\mathsf T}\), whose operator norm is \(2r_{H,n}\). Moreover, negativity of the factual-coordinate field \(\widehat S_{pq}\) need not give a fixed source direction robust to that larger box. The proposed source-product trigger and the explicit scalar perturbation allowance are sufficient for a terminating certified chord.
The corrected fixed-confidence theorem needs a threshold that may grow with \(\log(1/\delta)\); the original class-only description is not valid uniformly over arbitrarily small \(\delta\).
The proof is asymptotic and does not use the endpoint-response OEQ; the replacement records both the necessary large-sample qualifier and the exact proof spine.
narrow: The packing choice and the limit \(\chi^2\to0\) prove the separation bound for all sufficiently large \(n_\ast\). The current unqualified conclusion omits that limit condition.

narrow: The displayed asymptotic simplifications require \(\ell_n/n_\ast\to0\). With \(\delta\) allowed to approach zero arbitrarily fast, no threshold independent of \(\delta\) ensures even \(h_n<1\); fixing \(\delta\) and allowing the threshold to depend on it is the honest scope supported by the rate calculation.

verdict.note: Accepted the corrected certificate construction and necessary asymptotic quantifier repairs; rejected the certificate proposition because B_n alone does not imply clipping inactivity and the stronger source-product trigger does not preserve the promised negative-margin-endpoint result.
